summary: Bidirectional coverage is strong for authority/409, LKG, PROXY-once, drain deadline, recovery, and most stream/eligibility paths after the 6298f2cf remediation, but same_zone_preferred × empty-local × fail_open eligibility remains grading-ambiguous relative to verifier assertions, and the instruction-required control-channel status envelope is untested.

evidence.observation: Exactly 20 functional bullets; R13 requires combining zone and fail-open exactly as documented; R6 requires hello/prepare/prepared/rejected/activate/active/status envelopes; R20 incorporates /app/sovereign-lb/docs.

States same-zone-preferred uses local first and remote 'only when local policy permits fallback', and fail-open may include unhealthy/ejected but never disabled/removed/expired-drain. Does not define empty-local behavior or whether fail_open expands zone eligibility.
Names zone_policy values and explicit fail_open but gives no eligibility matrix for same_zone_preferred with zero local targets or fail_open interaction.
same_zone_preferred + fail_open=false with only a remote-zone target expects no forwarding, encoding hard non-fallback when local set is empty.

Uses scenario desired with same_zone_preferred + fail_open=true and targets in zone-a and zone-b; asserts both echo and slow backends are hit, which only reconciles with the prior test under an undocumented fail_open↔zone-expansion rule or an undocumented soft-preference rule.
echo-pool is same_zone_preferred with fail_open true and mixed-zone targets; this is the shared baseline for several stream tests including round-robin.
Defines bidirectional control-channel status envelopes with bounded readiness/generation/listener/connection/health fields; instruction R6 lists status among required envelopes.
Verifier exercises hello/prepare/prepared/rejected and HTTP/dataplane status readiness, but never asserts control-channel type=status exchange semantics.
LKG active generation preservation, continued listener service, and non-reuse of failed generation ids are covered and match rollout-state.md/operations.md.
Exactly-one PROXY v2 header and no repeat are graded via lab events; discoverable from dataplane.md plus tools/lab backends event interface.
Drain deadline force-close is graded and aligned with dataplane.md draining contract.
HTTP 200/202/409/422/400 mutation outcomes and generation-number strict increase after failed candidates are explicit; matches authority/conflict verifier behaviors.

findings.why_it_matters: Competing readings of same_zone_preferred (hard same-zone vs soft fallback when local empty) and whether fail_open expands zone eligibility change which targets are selectable. Verifier asserts no remote forwarding for remote-only + fail_open=false, while round-robin on the stock scenario expects both local and remote backends under same_zone_preferred + fail_open=true. Solvers cannot uniquely derive the graded eligibility matrix from the documented contracts.
findings.minimal_remediation: In dataplane.md (and a one-line configuration.md cross-reference if needed), publish an explicit eligibility matrix for same_zone_preferred covering: local nonempty; local empty with remote normally-eligible; and the exact effect of fail_open on zone membership versus unhealthy/ejected inclusion. Keep instruction R13 as the work request; do not encode hidden-test fixtures.
findings.regression_risk: Clarifying the matrix may reveal that either the remote-skip test or the mixed-zone round-robin baseline needs a Q2 adjustment if the intended product semantics cannot satisfy both.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction R6 and control-protocol.md require a bidirectional control-channel status envelope with bounded fields. The verifier never asserts status-frame accept/reject or body bounds, so a solver can omit that envelope and still pass while appearing to miss a stated protocol obligation.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add a behavioral assertion that a well-formed control status exchange is accepted and/or that an invalid status envelope does not advance authority; or, if status is not graded, remove it from the instruction envelope list while retaining HTTP/dataplane status obligations under R17.
findings.regression_risk: Low if a narrow status-frame check is added beside existing torn-frame/session fence tests; higher if the instruction list is trimmed without updating docs consistency.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction says 'at most one' PROXY header when enabled; docs/tests require exactly one on first backend establish. Docs resolve grading, but instruction wording is slightly weaker.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional Q3 nibble: change instruction phrasing to 'exactly one' when proxy_protocol_v2 is enabled.

findings.why_it_matters: R1 language/structure preservation and R19 exclusion surface are stated but not behaviorally graded; acceptable as non-graded safety/scope guardrails unless later tests assert them.
findings.minimal_remediation: No change required unless exclusions become graded.
